show.description: After being dumped at the marriage registrar for a richer man, struggling techie Aditya impulsively marries a stranger, Preeti, unaware she is a billionaire CEO. What begins as a deal-driven marriage turns explosive when Aditya is revealed to be the long-lost heir of a powerful business family, and the very man who humiliated him becomes his rival. As love, identity, and ambition collide, Aditya must choose between revenge, legacy, and the woman who believed in him first.
